action_items: (Cosmetic) Standardise brand.whatsappUrl in /app/frontend/src/mock/mock.js to https://wa.me/91… so BookMe / Loyalty / Contact all use the same short link format used by the admin WhatsApp reply.
critical_code_review_comments: availability.py create_slot: after model_dump() we overwrite start/end to None when full_day, but the request payload can still include start/end that pass the HH:MM regex validator without being stored — acceptable but consider stripping in the pydantic layer for cleanliness.

content.py service update: POST auto-computes 'no' as zfill(count+1) but PUT/DELETE don't renumber remaining services — after deleting a middle service the 'no' labels become non-sequential in the list view. Non-blocking (used cosmetically) but worth noting.
content.py store_image only validates extension (jpg/png/webp/gif) — not magic bytes; a renamed .txt→.jpg would still upload (documented in iter 3 — carry-over).
studio.py showcase endpoint has `regenerate=true` query param that would burn LLM credits if hit publicly (no auth). Consider gating regenerate behind admin auth to prevent abuse.
BookMeCompact.jsx uses brand.whatsappUrl (api.whatsapp.com/send) while Admin.jsx builds wa.me links — inconsistent. Not a functional bug.
